interest: A Japanese 'noiseless machine gun' and an airfield in Siam.
overview: This State Department file contains documents from January 1935 and April 1939 relating to Japanese military equipment, weaponry, and strategic installations, primarily filed under decimal classifications 894.243 (small arms and ammunition) and 894.24592 (military aviation and airfields). The primary component consists of a January 1935 confidential report and transmittal from Special Assistant Warrington Dawson at the U.S. Embassy in Paris forwarding a clipping from the French periodical La Tribune des Nations regarding an alleged noiseless, powderless electric machine gun invented by Yoshitaro Shimizu at the Tokyo Military Laboratory. The file also preserves an April 1939 internal memorandum from Joseph W. Ballantine of the Division of Far Eastern Affairs concerning reports from Singapore of Japanese airfield construction and material deliveries in southern Siam (Thailand).
